run_compute_metrics_stage: run the private computation compute metrics stage by starting MPC containers for lift or attribution games
get_compute_metrics_status: get the latest status of a private computation instance from the compute metrics stage service
stop_compute_metrics_service: stop the compute metrics stage service and terminate all associated MPC containers
get_compute_metrics_game_args: get the MPC game arguments for onedocker containers based on the private computation instance configuration
get_attribution_game_args: get attribution-specific game arguments including aggregators, attribution rules, and XOR encryption settings for MPC containers
